name: four-user-states-differential
description: External clean-vs-widescreen replay plan for three reported softlock-adjacent states plus an unlocked world-map state. Route macros are diagnostic branches, not claims about the intended player route.

spriteNames.0x0070: Current world boss / King K. Rool

states.identity: Croctopus Chase, level 0x0025, entrance 0x003E; underwater softlock-adjacent report

branches.hypothesis: Separates autonomous enemy/culling changes from controller-driven movement.
Replays the observed RIGHT+B approach and catches the point where Diddy reached state 0x002B.
Tests the alternate downward turn visible near the rock wall before continuing right.

states.identity: Poison Pond, level 0x0017, entrance 0x0022; Enguarde softlock-adjacent report

branches.hypothesis: Records autonomous fish/obstacle spawning without changing Enguarde position.
Advances through the nearby section while exercising Enguarde's B action.
Control branch for the same movement using Y instead of B.

states.identity: Gang-Plank Galleon, level 0x004C, entrance 0x0068; King K. Rool encounter

branches.hypothesis: Checks whether the boss encounter advances or stalls without player movement.
Approaches King K. Rool with normal running input and records boss-state transitions.
Approaches, jumps once, and continues right to expose collision/encounter gating differences.

states.identity: Unlocked Gang-Plank Galleon world map; navigation and level-selection test state

branches.hypothesis: World-map smoke test that catches unintended state or actor churn.
Exercises one deterministic navigation direction while preserving the unlocked state for reload.
